answer: Because the haven weight is recomputed from the wharf history each close, the nectar audit shows the reduced figure and the promotion is earned rather than bought. A new identity spends its first 2 epochs on probation, during which its attestations count for 36% of full weight. Running a farm thus buys partial influence at full price for each alias, and the discount only arrives after the operator has already paid the bond. That is 7 dollars per alias. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
